## What changed?

Describe the behavior or feature and why it helps the robot.

## How was it checked?

- [ ] Screen preview / software checks
- [ ] Actual hardware (describe which board, wiring and power supply)
- [ ] Not tested yet (explain what remains)

For movement changes, mention the starting pose, expected gesture, pulse bounds and Stop behavior. Do not include Wi-Fi passwords, device secrets, recordings or raw flash backups.

## Anything the team needs to know?

Mention changed wiring, dependencies, firmware compatibility or calibration requirements.
